title: POST /scenarios/{scenario_id}/duplicate golden characterization

characterized_route.notes: Persistence-heavy. Calls duplicate_scenario (write) plus 7 read-only queries plus 1 workspace_state read. No form input (path-parameter-only).

auth: Unauth -> 302 redirect to /login (NOT 401 JSON, NOT HX-Redirect)
Auth check happens FIRST in route body
path_parameter: Route signature: async def duplicate_scenario_endpoint(request: Request, scenario_id: str)
scenario_id is the URL path parameter
user_id_source: Never from form (no form input at all)
active_scenario: Route does NOT explicitly track active scenario beyond original
original_lookup: If original is None -> 404 JSON {error: 'Scenario not found'}
duplicate_persistence: duplicate_scenario(user.user_id, scenario_id) called once (after None check)
No replay_metadata or governance_state passed (repository is source of truth)
workspace_snapshot: workspace_state resolved inline in render call

intended_side_effects.ordering: auth -> get_scenario (with None check + 404 early return) -> duplicate_scenario -> get_project_by_code -> list_scenarios -> get_scenario_history -> list_exports -> build_export_lineage -> render

quirks_pinned: 2. 404 response is JSON, not HTML / not redirect / not template render
5. workspace_state resolved inline in render call (not in separate variable)
6. scenario_summary_cards has 10 specific fields (same shape as /scenarios/save)
7. scenario_summary_cards.export_count computed per scenario_name from export_lineage
8. Route is path-parameter-only (no await request.form(); different from /scenarios/save)
9. Route does NOT emit HX-Trigger or HX-Redirect (full workspace render)
10. Route is currently inline orchestration (no service pattern yet)
